import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_traj import Session

s = Session("place_phone_stand", instance="/app/instance.json")
env = s.env
arm = "left" if env.phone.get_pose().p[0] < 0 else "right"

s.record_start()
env.move(env.grasp_actor(env.phone, arm, pre_grasp_dis=0.12, grasp_dis=0.0))
env.move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, z=0.12, move_axis="world"))
target = env.stand.get_functional_point(0, "pose")
target.p[1] -= 0.09
# The phone's functional point settles short along +Y against this stand model.
env.move(env.place_actor(env.phone, arm, target, functional_point_id=0,
                         pre_dis=0.12, dis=0.025, is_open=True,
                         constrain="auto"))
env.move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, z=0.12, move_axis="world"))
env.move(env.open_gripper("left"))
env.move(env.open_gripper("right"))
actions = s.record_stop()
print("recorded", actions.shape, "plan_success", env.plan_success, "status", s.status())
replayed = s.replay(actions)
print("replay", replayed)
if not replayed["success"]:
    raise RuntimeError("trajectory did not pass replay")
s.save_trajectory(actions, "/app/output/trajectory.npz", meta={"arm": arm})
